propositions: Baseline description, status, and priority fields must be stored in normalized scalar form (ADF-to-text for description, Jira name string for status/priority) to achieve 50%+ serialized size reduction while preserving exact live-comparison mutation verdicts through real inbound/outbound mappers.
Assignee field must remain unchanged as a raw vendor dict to preserve all identity forms and prevent local-wins overwrites of concurrent remote assignee edits.

A projection helper in inbound_fields.py must normalize description/status/priority before equality comparison and storage in set_baseline, while remaining idempotent for already-scalar values and preserving field absence.

Pre-A3 reader must accept both vendor dict and scalar forms to enable rollback without lossy denormalization, verified by zero mutation deltas when the current store is replayed through exported pre-A3 code.
The complete stored baseline must remain byte-stable under repeated normalization passes with equivalent scalar and vendor-dict inputs, verified through integration test with git worktree validation.
